title: Drafted into the Army in 1963
summary: He went into the Army in January 1963 and heard Irma Thomas's million-seller while in service.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: You had to leave minute records for the Army. What happened? Were you drafted in 1963?

Right. That must have really disrupted things. A bit, yes. I was, by that time I was ready to go to the Army. I had been deferred a couple of times before then. And one time I was out because my left foot was in a cast from putting on trampoline shows. I had an accident. But I had been deferred a couple of times. So by January of 63, I didn't mind going to Army. A lot of artists did leave and ventured to other places. Of course, it was a blessing for some, seemingly. The first actual million seller that Irma had wished someone would care. After all of our recording days, her first real million seller was someone would care. And that was when I was in Army.
And you just heard it on the radio while you were probably on the case.

On the late one time I heard it and I thought it was gorgeous. Also, Aaron's first actual million seller being tell it like it is was one that I didn't do. That was after the Army period, at least during the Army period.
